To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) OpenStack can be used to provide a Cloud-based infrastructure for SAaaS; 2) a SAaaS platform can be realized by extending the capabilities of a Cloud platform with the support of the sensing and actuation layers; and 3) Stack4Things is a concrete implementation of a SAaaS platform based on OpenStack.
Stack4Things is a novel and complete framework that enables the provision of sensing and actuation capabilities as a service in the Cloud.
Stack4Things is a novel framework that allows to manage a large number of sensing and actuation devices through a cloud infrastructure.
In summary, our research is concerned with
providing a Cloud-based solution for the management of large-scale IoT infrastructures.

the definition of a Cloud-enabled SAaaS framework, which can be used as an enabler to support the integration and management of large numbers of sensing and actuation devices, thus paving the way toward the realization of the IoT vision.

the design of a framework that enables the management of a large number of sensing-and-actuating resources, by providing a unified view of their status and by enabling their control in an integrated way.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

Stack4Things is an effective framework to support the integration of IoT and Cloud, which is able to manage and orchestrate the sensing and actuation resources of the IoT nodes, as well as to collect the sensing data and make them available for further processing.
the proposed solution, by means of a novel approach, is able to provide the necessary tools for a proper management of sensing and actuation resources and their interactions.
Stack4Things represents a concrete step toward an integrated and interoperable solution for managing IoT and cloud resources.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Stack4Things is an open-source framework that provides an integrated and flexible platform for the deployment and management of IoT infrastructures.
Stack4Things is the first framework for the management of large scale IoT deployments in the Cloud.
Stack4Things is the result of the combination of a set of existing tools, such as OpenStack, with a set of new tools and algorithms, in order to provide a complete SAaaS framework.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the adoption of an open-source IaaS framework, such as OpenStack, is an effective way to provide a scalable and extensible platform for IoT and Cloud integration.
, in order to provide a complete SAaaS solution, a proper integration of the sensing and actuation capabilities of the IoT devices with the Cloud infrastructure is required.
the proposed framework can be considered as a first step toward a full-fledged SAaaS platform.
